description: React hook 'useAuth' for managing authentication state with Supabase, including OAuth via Google. Provides user session info, loading state, and sign-in/sign-out functions.

methods.name: useAuth()
methods.description: Hook that manages authentication state, exposes user info, session, loading state, and auth actions including Google OAuth.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Triggers OAuth sign-in flow with Google through Supabase.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user via Supabase auth.
